# These are patches from FE Builder that are in key/value array pairs. The first array
# contains the address for the value at the same index in the second array. They are 
# configured to install the FE Builder patches in the appropriate place in the randomizer
# so I recommand that you do not edit this file. As FE Builder is a GPLv3 licensed software
# I'm going to assume the patches it contains also have this license. You can search GPLv3
# on google for more information on what the GPLv3 license agreement means.
#
# The source code for all of these patches can be found by installing FE Builder and navigating
# to FEBuilderGBA\Config\patch2\FE7U then you can find the folder with the patch you are
# looking for. The only exception is the Display Growths (Magic Separation Compatible) patch
# which I modified from the original source code. You can find the source for that here:
# https://lonelychat.net/fe7randomizer/download/FE7-DisplayGrowthsMSC.zip
#
# Don't expect this source code to work in FE Builder. The only reason it worked while I was
# building it is because it was operating from a hardcoded location and it only works from
# that location. If FE Builder tries to install this then it won't know where it needs to
# be because I didn't know how to tell FE Builder how to do that. This modified patch was my
# first assembly project and I didn't know what I was doing yet.
#
# That being said the modified parts of the code are commented so you might be able to
# tell what I was trying to do. If you feel that will be helpful to you in some way then
# feel free to download the source code.
#
